--os-accent.title: Desktop accent
--os-accent.description: Sets the shell’s accent color for desktop highlights that use the desktop palette. Shared UI components can use the separate interface accent.
--os-accent.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-admin-bar-height.title: Admin bar height
--os-admin-bar-height.description: Sets the height of the desktop. Larger lengths give the element more vertical room.
--os-admin-bar-height.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-admin-bar-peek.title: Admin bar peek
--os-admin-bar-peek.description: Offsets admin bar peek within the desktop. Positive and negative lengths move it in opposite directions along the indicated edge or axis.
--os-admin-bar-peek.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-admin-bar-reveal-zone.title: Admin bar reveal zone
--os-admin-bar-reveal-zone.description: Sets the height of the desktop. Larger lengths give the element more vertical room.
--os-admin-bar-reveal-zone.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-admin-bar-slide.title: Admin bar slide duration
--os-admin-bar-slide.description: Sets how long the dynamic admin bar takes to slide down from its parked strip at the top edge, and back up. Station uses 180ms with ease timing. The preview pauses between reveals so you can see the motion.
--os-admin-bar-slide.inputHint: Use ms or s for time values, unless this is a documented runtime index.

--os-ai-panel-bg.title: Ai panel background
--os-ai-panel-bg.description: Paints the background of the desktop. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-ai-panel-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-app-tone.title: App tone
--os-app-tone.description: Paints the background of the desktop. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-app-tone.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-area-inset.title: Area inset
--os-area-inset.description: Offsets area inset within the desktop. Positive and negative lengths move it in opposite directions along the indicated edge or axis.
--os-area-inset.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-backstop.title: Backstop
--os-backstop.description: Paints the background of the desktop. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-backstop.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-bg.title: Desktop background
--os-bg.description: Paints the desktop behind windows, shortcuts and the dock. It accepts a flat color or a CSS gradient; uploaded wallpaper and desktop textures can cover it.
--os-bg.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-border.title: Desktop border color
--os-border.description: Sets the base border color for desktop surfaces that inherit the shell palette.
--os-border.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-beam.title: App panel beam
--os-cn-beam.description: Paints the background of the dock’s expanded app panel. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-cn-beam.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-beam-x.title: App-panel connector offset
--os-cn-beam-x.description: Moves the connector beam sideways so it still points to its dock icon when the panel is shifted. The shell normally updates this position.
--os-cn-beam-x.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-beam-y.title: App panel beam vertical
--os-cn-beam-y.description: Offsets app panel beam vertical within the dock’s expanded app panel. Positive and negative lengths move it in opposite directions along the indicated edge or axis.
--os-cn-beam-y.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-border.title: App panel border
--os-cn-border.description: Defines app panel border around the dock’s expanded app panel. Choose a color; width and style are controlled separately.
--os-cn-border.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-divider.title: App panel divider
--os-cn-divider.description: Defines app panel divider around the dock’s expanded app panel. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-cn-divider.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-fg.title: App panel text
--os-cn-fg.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s expanded app panel. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-cn-fg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-fg-muted.title: App panel text muted
--os-cn-fg-muted.description: Sets the quieter foreground color for the dock’s expanded app panel. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-cn-fg-muted.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-hue.title: App-panel spotlight hue
--os-cn-hue.description: Changes the hue of the pointer spotlight in the dock’s expanded app panel. Values follow the hue wheel: 0 is red, 120 green, 240 blue.
--os-cn-hue.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-cn-legend.title: App panel legend
--os-cn-legend.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s expanded app panel. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-cn-legend.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-max-h.title: App panel max height
--os-cn-max-h.description: Limits the maximum height of the dock’s expanded app panel. Larger lengths give the element more vertical room.
--os-cn-max-h.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-cn-radius.title: App panel radius
--os-cn-radius.description: Rounds the corners of the dock’s expanded app panel. Use 0 for square corners; larger lengths make the rounding more pronounced.
--os-cn-radius.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-row.title: App-panel row stagger
--os-cn-row.description: Sets the row index used to stagger the app panel’s entrance timing. Larger values delay the row; this is a per-row runtime value rather than a general color or spacing choice.
--os-cn-row.inputHint: Use ms or s for time values, unless this is a documented runtime index.

--os-cn-row-fill.title: App panel row fill
--os-cn-row-fill.description: Paints the background of the dock’s expanded app panel. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-cn-row-fill.inputHint: Upload image files in Textures; token values cannot contain URLs.

--os-cn-row-hue.title: App-panel row hue
--os-cn-row-hue.description: Changes the hue used for a row’s accent mark in the expanded app panel. The live shell can derive it from the app identity.
--os-cn-row-hue.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-cn-row-ink.title: App panel row text color
--os-cn-row-ink.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s expanded app panel. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-cn-row-ink.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-shadow.title: App panel shadow
--os-cn-shadow.description: Changes the shadow or ring on the dock’s expanded app panel. Use offsets, blur and color to control how the surface separates from its background.
--os-cn-shadow.inputHint: Use the value field for exact shadows; the visual shadow control replaces complex shadows with one layer.

--os-cn-shift.title: App-panel horizontal adjustment
--os-cn-shift.description: Shifts the expanded app panel sideways to keep it inside the viewport. This is normally calculated by the shell, so a fixed theme override may be replaced.
--os-cn-shift.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-surface.title: App panel surface
--os-cn-surface.description: Paints the background of the dock’s expanded app panel. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-cn-surface.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-cn-x.title: Spotlight horizontal position
--os-cn-x.description: Moves the app-panel spotlight left or right. Use a percentage: 0% is the left edge and 100% the right edge.
--os-cn-x.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-y.title: Spotlight vertical position
--os-cn-y.description: Moves the app-panel spotlight up or down. Use a percentage: 0% is the top and 100% the bottom.
--os-cn-y.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-cn-z.title: App panel z
--os-cn-z.description: Sets the stacking priority of app panel z. Higher numbers appear above lower numbers within the same stacking context; this does not change size or position.
--os-cn-z.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-danger.title: Desktop danger color
--os-danger.description: Colors destructive actions and danger feedback in the desktop shell.
--os-danger.state: Used for destructive actions or failure feedback.
--os-danger.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-desktop-image.title: Desktop texture
--os-desktop-image.description: Supplies the artwork layer for the desktop. Use the Textures editor to upload PNG, SVG or another supported image; URL values cannot be stored directly in token overrides.
--os-desktop-image.inputHint: Upload image files in Textures; token values cannot contain URLs.

--os-desktop-image-position.title: Desktop texture position
--os-desktop-image-position.description: Places the artwork within the desktop. For example, left top pins it to a corner, while center keeps it centered.
--os-desktop-image-position.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-desktop-image-repeat.title: Desktop texture repeat
--os-desktop-image-repeat.description: Chooses how artwork repeats on the desktop. Use repeat for a tiled texture, repeat-x or repeat-y for one axis, or no-repeat for a single image.
--os-desktop-image-repeat.inputHint: Choose a repeat keyword; frame edges use stretch / repeat / round / space.

--os-desktop-image-size.title: Desktop texture size
--os-desktop-image-size.description: Sets the scale of the artwork on the desktop. Use auto for its natural size, cover to fill the surface, contain to fit it, or one/two explicit lengths.
--os-desktop-image-size.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-dock-badge-bg.title: Dock badge background
--os-dock-badge-bg.description: Paints the background of the notification badge on a dock icon. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-badge-bg.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-badge-computed-size.title: Dock badge computed size
--os-dock-badge-computed-size.description: Sets the minimum width of the notification badge on a dock icon. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-badge-computed-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-badge-fg.title: Dock badge text
--os-dock-badge-fg.description: Sets the foreground color for the notification badge on a dock icon. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-dock-badge-fg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-badge-font-size.title: Dock badge font size
--os-dock-badge-font-size.description: Sets the text size in the notification badge on a dock icon. Larger values increase emphasis and can require more room in the layout.
--os-dock-badge-font-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-badge-font-weight.title: Dock badge text weight
--os-dock-badge-font-weight.description: Sets the text weight in the notification badge on a dock icon. A higher number usually appears bolder; the available weights depend on the chosen font.
--os-dock-badge-font-weight.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-dock-badge-offset.title: Dock badge offset
--os-dock-badge-offset.description: Offsets dock badge offset within the notification badge on a dock icon. Positive and negative lengths move it in opposite directions along the indicated edge or axis.
--os-dock-badge-offset.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-dock-badge-padding.title: Dock badge padding
--os-dock-badge-padding.description: Sets the inner space in the notification badge on a dock icon. Padding separates content from its container’s edges; increasing it makes the layout roomier.
--os-dock-badge-padding.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-badge-size.title: Dock badge size
--os-dock-badge-size.description: Sets the minimum width of the notification badge on a dock icon. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-badge-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-bg.title: Dock surface
--os-dock-bg.description: Paints the dock behind its app icons. A transparent dock texture reveals this background underneath.
--os-dock-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-bg-image.title: Dock texture
--os-dock-bg-image.description: Supplies the artwork layer for the dock. Use the Textures editor to upload PNG, SVG or another supported image; URL values cannot be stored directly in token overrides.
--os-dock-bg-image.inputHint: Upload image files in Textures; token values cannot contain URLs.

--os-dock-bg-image-position.title: Dock texture position
--os-dock-bg-image-position.description: Places the artwork within the dock. For example, left top pins it to a corner, while center keeps it centered.
--os-dock-bg-image-position.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-dock-bg-image-repeat.title: Dock texture repeat
--os-dock-bg-image-repeat.description: Chooses how artwork repeats on the dock. Use repeat for a tiled texture, repeat-x or repeat-y for one axis, or no-repeat for a single image.
--os-dock-bg-image-repeat.inputHint: Choose a repeat keyword; frame edges use stretch / repeat / round / space.

--os-dock-bg-image-size.title: Dock texture size
--os-dock-bg-image-size.description: Sets the scale of the artwork on the dock. Use auto for its natural size, cover to fill the surface, contain to fit it, or one/two explicit lengths.
--os-dock-bg-image-size.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-dock-border.title: Dock border
--os-dock-border.description: Defines dock border around the dock. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-dock-border.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-divider.title: Dock divider
--os-dock-divider.description: Paints the background of the dock. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-divider.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-exit-icon.title: Dock exit icon
--os-dock-exit-icon.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s exit control. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-dock-exit-icon.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-exit-ring.title: Dock exit ring
--os-dock-exit-ring.description: Changes the shadow or ring on the dock’s exit control. This token supplies the shadow or ring color; its geometry comes from the component.
--os-dock-exit-ring.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-exit-ring-hover.title: Dock exit ring on hover
--os-dock-exit-ring-hover.description: Changes the shadow or ring on the dock’s exit control. This token supplies the shadow or ring color; its geometry comes from the component.
--os-dock-exit-ring-hover.state: Used when the pointer is over the control.
--os-dock-exit-ring-hover.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-floating-bg.title: Floating dock background
--os-dock-floating-bg.description: Paints the background of the floating dock rail. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-floating-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-floating-border.title: Floating dock border
--os-dock-floating-border.description: Defines floating dock border around the floating dock rail. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-dock-floating-border.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-floating-border-top.title: Floating dock border top
--os-dock-floating-border-top.description: Defines floating dock border top around the floating dock rail. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-dock-floating-border-top.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-floating-highlight.title: Floating dock highlight
--os-dock-floating-highlight.description: Changes the shadow or ring on the floating dock rail. Use offsets, blur and color to control how the surface separates from its background.
--os-dock-floating-highlight.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-floating-shadow.title: Floating dock shadow
--os-dock-floating-shadow.description: Changes the shadow or ring on the floating dock rail. This token supplies the shadow or ring color; its geometry comes from the component.
--os-dock-floating-shadow.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-icon-color.title: Dock icon color
--os-dock-icon-color.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s app icons. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-dock-icon-color.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-icon-color-hover.title: Dock icon color on hover
--os-dock-icon-color-hover.description: Sets the foreground color for the dock’s app icons. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-dock-icon-color-hover.state: Used when the pointer is over the control.
--os-dock-icon-color-hover.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-icon-size.title: Dock icon size
--os-dock-icon-size.description: Sets the text size in the dock’s app icons. Larger values increase emphasis and can require more room in the layout.
--os-dock-icon-size.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-dock-indicator-bg.title: Dock indicator background
--os-dock-indicator-bg.description: Paints the background of the dock’s running-app indicator. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-indicator-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-indicator-length.title: Dock indicator length
--os-dock-indicator-length.description: Sets the width of the dock’s running-app indicator. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-indicator-length.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-dock-indicator-thickness.title: Dock indicator thickness
--os-dock-indicator-thickness.description: Sets the height of the dock’s running-app indicator. Larger lengths give the element more vertical room.
--os-dock-indicator-thickness.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-dock-item-bg-hover.title: Dock item background on hover
--os-dock-item-bg-hover.description: Paints the background of an individual dock item. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-item-bg-hover.state: Used when the pointer is over the control.
--os-dock-item-bg-hover.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-item-image.title: Dock item texture
--os-dock-item-image.description: Supplies the artwork layer for the dock. Use the Textures editor to upload PNG, SVG or another supported image; URL values cannot be stored directly in token overrides.
--os-dock-item-image.inputHint: Upload image files in Textures; token values cannot contain URLs.

--os-dock-item-image-position.title: Dock item texture position
--os-dock-item-image-position.description: Places the artwork within the dock. For example, left top pins it to a corner, while center keeps it centered.
--os-dock-item-image-position.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-dock-item-image-repeat.title: Dock item texture repeat
--os-dock-item-image-repeat.description: Chooses how artwork repeats on the dock. Use repeat for a tiled texture, repeat-x or repeat-y for one axis, or no-repeat for a single image.
--os-dock-item-image-repeat.inputHint: Choose a repeat keyword; frame edges use stretch / repeat / round / space.

--os-dock-item-image-size.title: Dock item texture size
--os-dock-item-image-size.description: Sets the scale of the artwork on the dock. Use auto for its natural size, cover to fill the surface, contain to fit it, or one/two explicit lengths.
--os-dock-item-image-size.inputHint: Use CSS size/position values appropriate to the artwork.

--os-dock-item-outline.title: Dock item outline
--os-dock-item-outline.description: Defines dock item outline around an individual dock item. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-dock-item-outline.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-recycle-badge-bg.title: Dock recycle badge background
--os-dock-recycle-badge-bg.description: Paints the background of the recycle-bin counter in the dock. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-dock-recycle-badge-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-recycle-badge-computed-size.title: Dock recycle badge computed size
--os-dock-recycle-badge-computed-size.description: Sets the minimum width of the recycle-bin counter in the dock. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-recycle-badge-computed-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-recycle-badge-fg.title: Dock recycle badge text
--os-dock-recycle-badge-fg.description: Sets the foreground color for the recycle-bin counter in the dock. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-dock-recycle-badge-fg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-dock-recycle-badge-font-size.title: Dock recycle badge font size
--os-dock-recycle-badge-font-size.description: Sets the text size in the recycle-bin counter in the dock. Larger values increase emphasis and can require more room in the layout.
--os-dock-recycle-badge-font-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-recycle-badge-size.title: Dock recycle badge size
--os-dock-recycle-badge-size.description: Sets the minimum width of the recycle-bin counter in the dock. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-recycle-badge-size.inputHint: Use a direct CSS value. Unchanged defaults are inherited and do not count toward the 512-override limit.

--os-dock-width.title: Dock width
--os-dock-width.description: Sets the width of the dock. Larger lengths give the element more horizontal room.
--os-dock-width.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-drop-preview-bg.title: Drop preview background
--os-drop-preview-bg.description: Paints the background of the desktop. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-drop-preview-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-drop-preview-border.title: Drop preview border
--os-drop-preview-border.description: Defines drop preview border around the desktop. Use the color, width and style accepted by this border or outline property.
--os-drop-preview-border.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-fg.title: Desktop text
--os-fg.description: Sets the main foreground color for the desktop shell.
--os-fg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-fg-muted.title: Desktop secondary text
--os-fg-muted.description: Sets the quieter foreground color for secondary information in the desktop shell.
--os-fg-muted.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-fg-on-light.title: Text on light
--os-fg-on-light.description: Sets the foreground color for the desktop. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-fg-on-light.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-file-tile-enter-delay.title: File tile enter delay
--os-file-tile-enter-delay.description: Sets the wait before file tile enter delay starts in the desktop. Positive time values postpone the animation; negative values start partway through it.
--os-file-tile-enter-delay.inputHint: Use ms or s for time values, unless this is a documented runtime index.

--os-file-tile-enter-duration.title: File tile enter duration
--os-file-tile-enter-duration.description: Sets how long file tile enter duration takes in the desktop. Shorter durations feel quicker; longer durations make the motion more gradual. The specimen isolates the timing with a moving marker.
--os-file-tile-enter-duration.inputHint: Use ms or s for time values, unless this is a documented runtime index.

--os-folder-window-bg.title: Folder window background
--os-folder-window-bg.description: Paints the background of the desktop. Transparent colors and gradients let the surface underneath show through.
--os-folder-window-bg.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-folder-window-fg-muted.title: Folder window text muted
--os-folder-window-fg-muted.description: Sets the quieter foreground color for the desktop. Text and foreground marks use this value.
--os-folder-window-fg-muted.inputHint: Try a hex color such as #ec9bff, or rgba() for transparency.

--os-font.title: Desktop typeface
--os-font.description: Sets the base font family for the desktop shell and components that inherit its typography.

--os-fx-darken-brightness.title: Background effect darken brightness
--os-fx-darken-brightness.description: Adjusts brightness in this backdrop effect. Use 1 for unchanged brightness, less than 1 to darken and more than 1 to brighten.
--os-fx-darken-brightness.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-fx-darken-saturate.title: Background effect darken saturate
--os-fx-darken-saturate.description: Adjusts color intensity in this backdrop effect. Use 1 for unchanged saturation, less than 1 for muted colors and more than 1 for stronger colors.
--os-fx-darken-saturate.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--os-fx-frost-blur.title: Background effect frost blur
--os-fx-frost-blur.description: Blurs the affected backdrop. A larger pixel length softens more detail; 0px keeps it sharp.
--os-fx-frost-blur.inputHint: Use a CSS length or percentage. Keep the unit unless the property accepts a bare number.

--os-fx-frost-brightness.title: Background effect frost brightness
--os-fx-frost-brightness.description: Adjusts brightness in this backdrop effect. Use 1 for unchanged brightness, less than 1 to darken and more than 1 to brighten.

--os-z-mio.inputHint: Use a numeric value; keep any required unit shown by the default.

--wp-admin-theme-color.title: WordPress admin accent
